app.name: Unauth Fraud Intelligence
app.short_description: Identity confidence and claims context on every Zendesk ticket.
app.long_description: Shows Unauth store checks, network context, and case reports in the ticket sidebar using your Unauth API key.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Download the zip from Unauth → Settings → Integrations → Zendesk.
2. In Zendesk Admin → Apps → Upload private app, upload the zip (manifest.json at the root).
3. Set **Unauth app URL** to your Unauth deployment (e.g. https://unauth-pi.vercel.app).
4. Paste your Unauth API key from Settings → Integrations → Advanced.
5. Install the app to the ticket sidebar, then click **Verify install** in Unauth.

app_base_url.label: Unauth app URL
app_base_url.helpText: HTTPS URL of your Unauth deployment (no trailing slash). Example: https://unauth-pi.vercel.app

api_key.label: Unauth API key
api_key.helpText: Create an API key in Unauth under Settings → Integrations → Advanced (API keys).
